name: refactor-agentic-instructions
description: Review AI agent instructions for maintainability problems, then apply only the refactoring changes the user selects.

interface.longDescription:
Make AI agent instructions clearer and easier to maintain. Review AGENTS.md, skills, plugin guidance, and related files for duplication, contradictions, stale details, and unclear boundaries. Then apply only the changes you select in the same task.

The plugin needs access to the instruction sources. Refactoring aims to preserve intended behavior, but you should review the resulting diff and test important workflows.
defaultPrompt: Find refactoring opportunities in my local Codex instructions and skills.
Review this repository's agent instructions for duplication and conflicts.
Apply only the instruction refactoring changes I selected above.
